text:
Emmalee: Heads up 02 AcmeHealth ready to move from evaluation to a 30-day Dedicated pilot. They want PO + W9, Net30, and a tightened pilot SLA. Can legal/finance confirm acceptance path?
chris_legal: I have their markups. They want 99.9% for the pilot and a right to one compliance review. Both doable but need to limit scope & liability. Not a flat 'open audit'.
devon_finance: PO before activation is standard. We can do Net30. Need PO number, billing contact, and vendor W9. They asked about ACH vs check 1 any preference?
Emmalee: Acme prefers ACH. Billing contact is m.lopez@acmehealth.com. They also asked for our bank details on the invoice.
chris_legal: We don't publish bank details until contract countersigned. For the SLA, propose a pilot addendum: elevated uptime for pilot only, capped service credits = pilot fees, and auto-revert to standard SLA unless renewed. Also limit audit to 1 remote review with 30 days' notice and at Customer's cost.
anita_pm: From delivery side, we need final signer emails and the orderform ID to pre-provision routes. Onboarding needs a primary signer, backup, and billing contact mapped in Console.
sam_solutions: Also FYI: we'll need a short statement in the order form about data residency (us-east-1) for the pilot per their security note.
Emmalee: Signers: j.park@acmehealth.com (VP Ops, primary), laura.fin@acmehealth.com (legal assistant, backup). Billing: m.lopez@acmehealth.com. Orderform ID requested.
devon_finance: Confirming we accept Net30 and ACH. We will issue invoice once we have PO number and W9; invoice will mark "Payable via ACH" and show bank instructions after countersign. PO amount?
Emmalee: PO amount: $48,500 (pilot + premium support line).
chris_legal: Draft addendum language: "For the Pilot Term only, Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to achieve 99.9% monthly uptime. Customer's sole remedy for Pilot service unavailability shall be service credits not to exceed total Pilot fees. Customer may request one remote compliance review during the Pilot Term with 30 days' prior notice; review scope limited to systems that process Customer Data and executed under Provider's confidentiality procedures"
maria_ps: (joined thread) addendum looks good. Add explicit 30-day Pilot Term dates in order form and state that any elevated SLA requires explicit written renewal.
chris_legal: I'll add that and produce a redline PDF. Emmalee, confirm you want DocuSign?
Emmalee: Yes, DocuSign. Also they requested a tax exemption certificate; Acme claims non-profit status and asked if we can accept org-level exemption on file.
devon_finance: We'll accept a tax exemption certificate if it's from the appropriate tax authority and attached to the PO. Still requires W9 for vendor verification.
signbot: docu-sign-bot: Envelope 0x9b3c prepared for j.park@acmehealth.com, laura.fin@acmehealth.com 1 signer(s) set.
sam_solutions: Pre-provision note: Console route name should be "acmehealth-pilot-08124". Emmalee, please confirm final orderform ID to attach to PO so we can sync provisioning.
Emmalee: Orderform ID: RF-24-ACME-007. Send PO with that ID; I'll ask them to attach W9 + tax-exempt cert.
devon_finance: Once PO + W9 arrive we'll issue invoice and kick activation. Net30 timeline begins on invoice date. Please confirm ACH beneficiary name will be Redwood Inference, Inc. (we'll add details post-countersign).
chris_legal: Redline and addendum uploaded to thread. I propose the following acceptance checklist before countersign: 1) PO with RF-24-ACME-007, 2) completed W9, 3) tax-exempt cert (if claimed), 4) signed DocuSign envelope.
Emmalee: Confirmed. I'm asking Acme to send PO + attachments now. 
signbot: docu-sign-bot: Envelope 0x9b3c sent to j.park@acmehealth.com and laura.fin@acmehealth.com at 2024-09-02T10:12:03Z
Emmalee: PO + W9 incoming from m.lopez@acmehealth.com. She attached a state tax-exempt letter. Forwarding to finance.
devon_finance: Received PO #ACME-2024-091. W9 and tax-exempt certificate received. We'll prepare invoice and wait for countersigned MSA to post bank instructions.
sam_solutions: DocuSign completed and onboarding checklist started. Emmalee 1 can you confirm Console route and signer mapping format?
Emmalee: Mapping: {"primary":"j.park@acmehealth.com","backup":"laura.fin@acmehealth.com","billing":"m.lopez@acmehealth.com"}. Route name: acmehealth-pilot-08124. Orderform RF-24-ACME-007 attached to PO#ACME-2024-091.
chris_legal: Countersigned MSA + Pilot Addendum generated. Routing to Emmalee for delivery. Closing once invoice posted and account enabled.
Emmalee: Great work team 1 closing when finance confirms invoice posted. :white_check_mark:
